character_lock.consistency: Use exactly the same original character identity, face, facial proportions, skin tone and clothing in every scene.

mother_character.identity: 34-year-old Pakistani mother, realistic Pakistani woman with natural human facial features, warm brown eyes, soft kind smile, wheatish warm skin tone, wearing a simple beige hijab neatly wrapped with full hair, neck and chest coverage and a modest traditional Pakistani shalwar kameez in soft cream and beige cotton with full sleeves
mother_character.note: Outfit colour (cream/beige) and skin tone are fixed here so she stays identical across shots.

environment_lock.location: A realistic middle-class Pakistani family home
environment_lock.living_room: Comfortable sofa, curtains, simple furniture and natural daylight
environment_lock.kitchen: Clean practical Pakistani home kitchen, cabinets, cooking utensils and stove
environment_lock.dining_room: Wooden dining table, simple chairs, plates and drinking glasses
environment_lock.decoration: Simple family photographs, indoor plants and modest home decoration

voices.ayesha: Natural young Pakistani girl's voice (around 11), soft, clear Urdu, light Karachi/Lahore urban accent
voices.mother: Warm gentle Pakistani woman's voice, calm pace, loving tone
voices.narrator: Clear friendly female voice, storytelling pace, standard Urdu

audio.background: Soft natural home ambience only, no music: distant birds, light kitchen sounds, ceiling fan hum

post_production_text.rule: Add all on-screen text (Arabic and Urdu) in the editor as overlays. Never ask the video model to draw lettering.
